about: What a test run may connect to. Read by app/core/target_guard.py (the backend tests and the isolated backend's start) and by frontend/e2e/support/target-policy.ts (the browser tests' preflight). Every comparison is exact: a host is recognised only as one of loopback_hosts, by its exact text and without a lookup; a database by its exact name; a Redis database by server port and number. Nothing is matched by a substring. Protected targets are checked first and win over any approval. A missing or malformed file, or one that approves a protected target for a role that may not use it, refuses every run.

backend-tests.about: The pytest suite. `test` is TEST_DATABASE_URL and the application settings' database, which must be one and the same; `race` is RACE_TEST_DATABASE_URL; `application` is every Redis client the application opens (the default and the six REDIS_DB_* roles); `lease` is LEASE_TEST_REDIS_URL's three databases.

test.why: the shared server's test database; the session fixture drops every table it created

application.why: guard-test-redis, the throwaway Redis: the whole server

lease.why: guard-test-redis, the throwaway Redis: the whole server

isolated-backend.about: The isolated backend (:8001) as scripts/local-servers.sh starts it, and what the browser preflight requires its GET /health to report.

application.why: the isolated pair's own databases on the shared server, one by one, not the server
